Jordan Reeves: Heads-up: the /rerank doc shows a single `score` per item in the JS/Python snippets but the raw API actually returns `scores` array now. Customers confused.

Tess Wu: Ugh, that's a stale example. We switched to multi-model rerank so docs should show `scores`. Keep a tiny helper to get the first score for single-model cases.

Diego Ramos: Runtime confirms canonical shape is `{items:[{id, scores:[...]}, ...]}`. SDKs sometimes map to topScore but docs need raw response + short helper.

Jordan Reeves: Plan: update curl/raw JSON to show `scores`, add two SDK snippets: raw parse (scores[0]) and SDK helper if available. Fix any stray Content-Type text in the example output blocks.

Priya Patel: On it. I'll open a PR against docs/ref rerank. Will include: 1) JSON example with `scores`, 2) JS + Python raw parse + helper snippets, 3) migration note for single-model users, 4) remove wrong content-type line.

Docs Bot: Please follow docs style guide for code blocks and inline field names. PR link will be posted after creation.

Tess Wu: For JS snippet prefer short examples:```javascript
// raw parse
const res = await client.rerank({model:'rwd-rank', inputs});
console.log(res.items.map(i=>i.scores[0]));
// helper (if SDK):
console.log(res.items.map(i=>i.topScore));
```

Priya Patel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3301. Lint failed due to stray terminal output; fixing now.

Docs Bot: Lint queued.

Diego Ramos: Reviewed helper names. Adjusted Python helper example to avoid inventing API surface. If SDK helper isn't present, show a tiny helper function:```python
def top_score(item):
    return item['scores'][0]
```

Jordan Reeves: Once PR is green merge and backport small wording to v1.2. Also create issue to add an examples-rendering test to catch the content-type glitch in the future.

Priya Patel: Fixed and pushed. PR merged. Issue #5621 created for rendering tests.
